mods.name: Build Sandbox
mods.description: Creates a separate creative flat world for testing builds without affecting survival gameplay.

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.9.0

🎯 Curios API compatibility for the sandbox inventory swap

## ✨ New Features

* 🧿 Added optional compatibility with **Curios API**
* 🔄 Curio slots (rings, trinkets, and other accessory items) are now swapped between Survival and the Build Sandbox, just like the main inventory
* 💾 Curio inventories are saved separately per dimension and persist across relogs and world restarts

## 🎮 Gameplay

* If Curios API is installed:

  * Entering the sandbox stores your Survival curios and loads your Sandbox curios (empty on first entry)
  * Exiting the sandbox restores your Survival curios and stores your Sandbox curios
* If Curios API is **not** installed, the mod works exactly as before — this integration is fully optional

## 🛠️ Technical Changes

* Added a safe Curios compatibility layer that only activates when Curios API is detected, so the mod runs fine with or without it
* Curio data is stored using Curios' own inventory serialization, so items with internal data (backpacks, storage items, etc.) keep their contents intact through the swap

---

🚧 Still actively working on the remaining known bugs — more fixes coming in the next update.

# 📌 Version 1.8.0

🎯 Customizable sandbox activation items and improved hotbar notifications

## ✨ New Features

* 🛠️ Added `/bsitem` system to customize sandbox activation items (per player)
* 🎨 Updated the design of hotbar messages for a cleaner and more modern UI
* 🖌️ The Brush is no longer the only activation item available

## 🎮 Gameplay

* Configure your activation item by holding a valid item and using:

  * `/bsitem`

* Reset your activation item to the default Brush using:

  * `/bsitem reset`

* Enter and exit the sandbox using:

  * `Shift + Right Click` with your configured activation item

* Restricted activation items:

  * 🧱 Blocks
  * 🥚 Spawn Eggs
  * 🛡️ Shields
  * 🏹 Bows
  * 🎯 Crossbows
  * 🔱 Tridents

## 💬 New Commands

* `/bsitem` → set the held item as your activation item
* `/bsitem reset` → restore the default Brush activation item

## 🎨 User Interface

* ✨ Updated all Build Sandbox hotbar messages
* 🎨 Added improved colored and styled notifications for:

  * Sandbox entry
  * Sandbox exit
  * Teleport countdown
  * Teleport cancellation
  * Activation item changes
  * Activation item reset

## 🛠️ Technical Changes

* Added per-player activation item storage
* Added activation item validation system
* Improved notification formatting across the mod

---

A quality-of-life update focused on customization and clearer in-game feedback 🧱

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.7.6

> 🧱 Smoother sandbox access and cleaner world generation

## ✨ New Features

* 🌍 Added a dedicated biome to the Build Sandbox dimension (no structures)
* 🎯 First-time sandbox entry now places you safely at Y = -52
* 🖌️ Shift + right click with a brush now toggles the sandbox
* ⚡ Added `/bs` as a shortcut for `/buildsandbox`

## 🎮 Gameplay

* Enter and exit the sandbox using:

  * `Shift + Right Click` with a brush

* 🖌️ Brush teleport behavior:

  * ⏳ 3-second countdown before teleporting

  * ❌ Can be cancelled by:

    * Releasing **Shift**
    * Changing the held item

  * 🏺 Does not activate when interacting with:

    * Suspicious Sand
    * Suspicious Gravel

* Safer first spawn to prevent falling into the void

## 💬 Commands

* `/buildsandbox` → main command

* `/bs` → shorter alias

* Commands **teleport instantly** (no countdown or restrictions)

## 🛠️ Technical Changes

* Introduced custom biome to fully disable structure generation
* Improved teleport handling for first-time sandbox access
* Simplified input handling for brush-based teleport

---

Small update focused on usability and sandbox world stability 🧱

readmeSummary: Build Sandbox is a NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that introduces an isolated creative test dimension designed for unrestricted building while preserving survival progression integrity.
